summary: The CREATE AI Act establishes the National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource (NAIRR) under the direction of the National Science Foundation. The NAIRR connects United States researchers, educators, students, and specific mission-driven employees with computational, data, software, and educational resources provided by federal agencies, state governments, and nongovernmental entities to advance artificial intelligence research and workforce skills.

affected_groups.effect: They are eligible to apply for access to computational, data, software, and educational resources provided by the NAIRR.
affected_groups.group: Researchers, educators, and students in the United States

affected_groups.effect: Small businesses with government funding and federally funded research and development centers are eligible for NAIRR access.
affected_groups.group: Small businesses and federal research entities

affected_groups.effect: They are explicitly prohibited from being authorized as eligible users of the NAIRR.
affected_groups.group: Individuals employed by specific foreign countries

key_provisions: Requires the Director of the National Science Foundation to establish the National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource within one year of enactment.
Establishes a Program Management Office within the Office of Advanced Cyberinfrastructure to oversee the NAIRR, manage budgets, coordinate resources, and set policies.
Grants eligible user access to U.S.-based researchers, educators, students, certain government employees, federally funded research centers, and qualified small businesses.
Excludes individuals employed by or acting on behalf of foreign countries listed in specific national security statutes from accessing the NAIRR.
Authorizes the Program Management Office to establish a fee schedule that includes a free tier of access and cost-based charges, while allowing retained fees to be used without further appropriation.
Requires adherence to National Security Presidential Memorandum-33 and its implementation guidance regarding research security and integrity.
Establishes an Advanced Cyberinfrastructure Advisory Committee to assess and make recommendations regarding the activities of the Office of Advanced Cyberinfrastructure and the NAIRR.
missing_information: Specific funding amounts or appropriations authorized by the bill.
Exact criteria for resource allocation and application review timelines beyond general process establishment.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The CREATE AI Act establishes the National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource (NAIRR) under the direction of the National Science Foundation. The NAIRR connects United States researchers, educators, students, and specific mission-driven employees with computational, data, software, and educational resources provided by federal agencies, state governments, and nongovernmental entities to advance artificial intelligence research and workforce skills.
summary_detail.significance: The bill creates a centralized federal resource structure to provide American researchers and students with access to advanced computing, data, and software tools for artificial intelligence, backed by management offices, security protocols, advisory committees, and structured user eligibility rules.
